name: SimpleRenderer (CPU Gaussian Splatting)
definition: A CPU-based rendering method for 3D Gaussian point clouds using a painter's algorithm. It projects 3D Gaussians to 2D screen ellipses and composites them to approximate Gaussian Splatting without CUDA, suitable for visualization and small-scale point clouds.
summary: SimpleRenderer is a CPU-based Gaussian Splatting method using a painter's algorithm for visualization when GPU acceleration is unavailable.
